scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspaces && cd backend && composer lint
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspaces && cd backend && composer test:coverage
scripts.precommit: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.prepush: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage --workspaces && (cd backend && composer test:behat && composer test:coverage && composer test:arch && composer analyse) && npm run build:admin && npm run build:timesheet
scripts.qa: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:behat && npm run build:admin && npm run build:timesheet
scripts.validate:thresholds: npm run test:coverage --workspaces && (cd backend && composer test:coverage && composer test:mutation) && npm run test:mutation:frontend
